answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops bulk fake identities. A new agent locks 100 POA in escrow; it unlocks only as a fingerprint builds: regular rhythm, varied counterparties. Iron is tested in a forge; a cedar grows ring by ring, so real history cannot appear overnight. A ferrous bond stays locked while behavior looks copied; proven fraud slashes it. Faking 1,000 identities locks 100,000 POA; an honest agent pays one bond and earns it back.
